interpretation: Shipped CPU table and refined policies qualify both predeclared binary endpoints in every held-out case (32/32, zero discordant pairs in 6144 paired histories each). Path length and exit energy screen inside margins wherever particles exit. Hard count changes in zero pairs everywhere, so it stays unresolved by the frozen rule, not failed. Per-track exit-energy differences from exact are at most ~3e-7 keV. CPU request ratios are single-process diagnostics on qlmc-ace, not production or equal-precision speedups.
